SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
I. D. REGISTRY
I. O. 587
20 - 9 - 16

September 16th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that a staffe officer from Nanking arrived on the 15th inst and handed to General Yang a letter from Feng Kou Chang which contained instructions as to steps to be taken to gather information regarding rumours of the formation of a Manchu Restoration Party.
On the 15th inst 150 infantry were transferred from Loongwha to the Woo Kyung Ing 沪军营 Camp near the Shanghai Hangchow Railway Station.
Tsang Siau Tien 莊小天 who held the rank of Colonel during the second revolution is now living at No.39 Tang Tih Pang 唐鐵浜 Frenchtown and is said to be now favouring the formation of a Manchu Restoration Party.
A number of dissatisfied rebels have opened an office for the repatriation of rebels at No.155 Rue Soongchan Frenchtown in opposition to the one already in existence.
It is rumoured that Wen Tsoong Yau 溫宗堯 who is strongly supported by Tang Shao Yi, will shortly replace Yang Tcheng as Commissioner of Foreign Affairs.
The painters strike is still on.
A night school for teaching the German language to Chinese has been opened at No.11 Bubbling Well Road by Pen Kyi Sun 潘桂生 a former employee of the German Consulate.
Over $20,000 were advanced by the Military Governor to the rebel leaders to be distributed amongst their followers before the Mid-Autumn festival on September 12th. It is believed that if this had not been done there would have been considerable trouble on that date and probably an outbreak of some kind or other.
Over sixty military students belonging to different provinces of China have been sent to their respective homes during this month at a cost which has been paid by the Military Governor. Total $3000.
One was suffering from injuries on the head received whilst he was manufacturing bombs in a house in the French Concession. Four were natives of Yunnan and eleven of Szechuen.

Your Obedient Servant,
（签名）
C.D.I.

Captain Superintendent.

情报登记处
587号情报
16-9-20

1916年9月16日

先生：

据报，一名来自南京的参谋军官于本月15日抵达，并向杨将军递交了一封冯国璋的信件，信中包含了关于采取措施收集有关组建满清复辟党谣言的情报的指示。

本月15日，150名步兵从龙华调往位于上海杭州火车站附近的沪军营营地。

在二次革命期间拥有上校军衔的莊小天（Tsang Siau Tien），现居住于法租界唐鐵浜39号，据说目前倾向于支持组建满清复辟党。

一些不满的反叛者在法租界宋禅路（Rue Soongchan）155号开设了一个反叛者遣返办公室，以对抗已存在的那个机构。

有谣言称，得到唐绍仪强力支持的溫宗堯（Wen Tsoong Yau），不久将接替杨增燧（Yang Tcheng）出任外交专员。

油漆工罢工仍在继续。

前德国领事馆雇员潘桂生（Pen Kyi Sun）在南京西路11号开办了一所夜校，向中国人教授德语。

军事督军在9月12日中秋节之前，向反叛领袖预支了超过20,000元，以便在其追随者中分发。人们相信，若不这样做，当天将会发生相当大的麻烦，并可能爆发某种骚乱。

本月，六十多名来自中国各省的军校学生被遣送回家，费用由军事督军支付。总计3000元。

其中一人在法租界一处房屋内制造炸弹时头部受伤。四人籍贯云南，十一人籍贯四川。

您顺从的仆人，
（签名）
C.D.I.

警司。
